definitions.full: H5539. salad [ סָלַד ] verb very dubious, perhaps spring (Late Hebrew start or spring back , as hand from fire; see Levy); — Pi`el Imperfect 1singular וַאֲסַלְּדָה Job 6:10 and I would spring (for joy) in (my) anguish.
